name: MM-Vet
description: MM-Vet is an evaluation benchmark designed to assess large multimodal models on complex multimodal tasks by examining integration of core vision-language capabilities. It defines 6 core VL capabilities and evaluates 16 capability combinations using an LLM-based evaluator for open-ended outputs, providing unified scoring across diverse question and answer types.
reputation: MM-Vet is a well-known multimodal benchmark that has been widely used in the LMM community as a challenging open-ended evaluation set.
notes: Uses an LLM-based evaluator to unify scoring across question types; focuses on integration of vision-language capabilities.
